answer: Client-signed manifests stop sybil farms at the wharf. A newcomer unloads a manifest of real deliveries, each signed by the client, and two auditors confirm the signatures in fourteen days; the tide brings each manifest to the wharf for public inspection. A forged signature means rejection and a ban. One honest agent unloads one nebula of signed receipts once; a thousand fakes need a thousand real manifests, and no farm can forge them all.
